title: Documenting decisions, failures and lessons for whoever comes next

videos.script: Six months from now, somebody opens the triage prompt for the first time. The examples are long lines of JSON, and they are hard to read. {{prompt}} The obvious fix is to make them easier to read. It was tried in August, and it took the score from thirty-six to zero. {{log}} The history has both commits. It does not have the reason. A commit message says what changed, and almost never why. {{why}} This lesson writes the why down, in three short notes kept beside the prompt. A decision record says why the prompt is the way it is, and what was tried instead. {{record}} A failure log says what went wrong, what caught it, and which test now keeps it from coming back. {{failure}} And a prompt card is for anybody who uses the prompt. It says what the prompt is for, what it costs, and how well it does on every test set. That includes the one that does not flatter it. {{card}} None of it is clever. All of it is cheap while the reason is still in your head. {{close}}
